evidence_items.title: Official Next-Gen IRON hardware and compute claims
evidence_items.claim: XPeng says Next-Gen IRON has 82 total degrees of freedom, a 22-DoF hand, an all-solid-state battery, and three Turing AI chips with 3000 TOPS effective compute.
evidence_items.notes: Official and state-media reporting align on the core claimed specs; no independent measurement was found.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Establishes concrete claimed hardware capabilities, while not proving useful work.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: With 82 degrees of freedom throughout the body... the hand has 22 degrees of freedom... equipped with 3 Turing AI chips, with an effective computing power of 3000 TOPS.
evidence_items.source_location: XPENG Shares Achievements in Physical AI Emergence, humanoid robot section
evidence_items.verification_notes: Company claim corroborated as reported claim by CGTN; not independently tested.

evidence_items.title: Public stage demo showed walking and exposed internals, not useful work
evidence_items.claim: Live Science reported IRON's AI Day unveiling, including the stage walk and XPeng cutting open the robot to address claims that a person was inside.
evidence_items.notes: Useful as public demo context only; source does not establish teleoperation status, continuity, or task success.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Supports limited controlled-stage mobility evidence and existence of a physical robot.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: The machine is equipped with 82 degrees of freedom, including 22 in each hand.
evidence_items.source_location: Live Science article, IRON man section
evidence_items.verification_notes: Source-backed but scoped to reported context.

evidence_items.title: Commercial roadmap and Baosteel exploration claim
evidence_items.claim: XPeng says Next-Gen IRON will first prioritize commercial scenarios such as guided tours, shopping guides, and traffic diversion; Baosteel is named as an ecosystem partner for exploring inspection and other industrial scenarios.
evidence_items.notes: This is future-looking roadmap evidence, not completed deployment evidence.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Clarifies intended commercial path and partner exploration without proving field performance.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Next-Gen IRON will prioritize entering commercial scenarios to provide services such as guided tours, shopping guides, and traffic diversion.
evidence_items.source_location: XPENG Shares Achievements in Physical AI Emergence, monetization plan paragraph
evidence_items.verification_notes: Official claim also summarized by CGTN; no Baosteel operating metrics found.

evidence_items.title: First-generation IRON context
evidence_items.claim: CnEVPost reported XPeng's first-generation IRON as 178 cm, 70 kg, with over 60 joints, and said it was working its way into XPeng factories.
evidence_items.notes: Historical first-generation context only; do not apply the height/weight values to Next-Gen IRON unless a current official source confirms them.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Shows platform continuity and earlier factory-intent reporting, but remains weak proof of production work.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Iron stands 178 cm tall and weighs 70 kg... currently working its way into Xpeng's factories.
evidence_items.source_location: CnEVPost 2024 AI Day article, Humanoid robot Iron section
evidence_items.verification_notes: Credible EV trade reporting of company event; no factory metrics or third-party audit.

arena_prompt_summary.one_paragraph_summary: XPeng Next-Gen IRON has stronger source-backed hardware evidence than the previous weak pack showed: official materials claim 82 total DoF, 22-DoF hands, an all-solid-state battery, bionic spine/muscle/skin construction, and three Turing AI chips at 3000 TOPS. The useful-work case remains weak: public evidence is a controlled stage walking demo plus a roadmap toward commercial service scenarios and Baosteel exploration, with no independent task benchmark or deployment metrics.
strongest_evidence: Official Next-Gen IRON claims: 82 total DoF, 22-DoF hand, all-solid-state battery, and 3 Turing AI chips with 3000 TOPS effective compute.
Official roadmap names commercial service scenarios and Baosteel exploration for inspection, but not completed deployment results.
Live Science and CGTN report the controlled public walking demo and suit-rumor response.
weakest_evidence: No public intervention/failure-rate, uptime, task-success, or raw autonomous task logs.
Teleoperation/editing details remain unclear for public demo footage.
